result.title: From Events to Reasoning: Hierarchical Rule Composition over Explicit States
result.summary: What a reasoning system emits is a conclusion; what it owes is a justification. Producing one requires every operation to be admissible on the facts actually available, the dependencies of intermediate results to survive to the end of the path, and the path to be revised when a premise changes. We present the Event Reasoning System (ERS), in which the reasoning state is an explicit event graph. Semantic features nominate candidate objects and rule bindings, and declared rule and task conditions decide which may execute, so candidates that violate the represented period, unit, or evidence constraints cannot enter an accepted reasoning path. Low-level rules provide reusable local transformations, and recursively composable high-level control rules organize subgoals and legal paths under the current goal, information gaps, and budget; a finite library is thereby rebound into paths never stored as complete solutions. We formalize admissible transitions, task-dependent control, compositional expressivity, dependency-preserving revision, and the gap between reachable solutions and those a budgeted controller finds. On structured-event graphs, ERS builds dependency chains of up to twelve steps, cuts irrelevant executed domain operations from 32 to 0 as lookahead grows to 16, and produces no unsupported target output across 24 negative cases; with rules frozen, it passes 12/12 focused checks comprising nine accepted derivations involving unseen input/path combinations and three justified refusals, as well as 6/6 fact-change cases. On fourteen jointly solved development tasks, the recorded dynamic subgoal configuration uses 51.6% less inference wall-clock time than single-level global control under their respective frozen settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Event Reasoning System（ERS），把推理状态表示为显式事件图：低层规则做可复用的局部变换，可递归组合的高层控制规则依据当前目标、信息缺口与预算组织子目标和合法路径，并形式化了可容许转移、依赖保持的修订以及「可达解」与「预算控制器实际找到的解」之间的差距；实验显示增大 lookahead 可把无关操作从 32 降到 0，分层动态子目标控制比单层全局控制少用约 51.6% 推理墙钟时间。
AI.relevance_reason: 显式事件图状态加分层预算化控制，为 LVR 的推理状态更新、何时深挖/何时停止（THINK 与 STOP 的收益-成本权衡）、以及剪除与目标无关的计算提供了可核查的方法线索；但其状态是符号规则而非神经 latent，也无视觉或多模态输入，向视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态控制的迁移尚属推测，需较多核查，故列为 P2。
